headline: Xiaomi Shares Rise Following Strong Smartphone Sales
summary: Xiaomi shares increased after the company reported better-than-expected smartphone sales, highlighting its successful shift toward premium devices.
why: Xiaomi's performance in the premium segment is a key indicator of its ability to maintain margins despite volatility in memory chip prices.

impacts.name: Xiaomi
impacts.why: Strong sales performance boosts investor confidence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company's ability to outperform sales expectations in the premium smartphone market drove the share price higher.
